description: This file contains functions and logic related to identifying, testing, and upgrading firmware images for various hardware models, specifically targeting a bcm47xx platform. It includes functions for parsing firmware headers, matching firmware images to device models, and executing upgrade procedures based on image type.
external_files: used to read device model info

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic number from a file at a specific offset.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 4-byte number from a file at a specific offset.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns expected device-specific image identifier based on the model read from system info.

methods.name: bcm47xx_identify
methods.description: Identifies the type of firmware image by examining its magic number and headers.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs checks on the firmware image to verify correctness and compatibility with the device.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_chk_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract TRX firmware from aCHK format image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_cybertan_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract TRX firmware from a CyberTAN format image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxl_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract TRX firmware from a Luxul V1 format image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxlold_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract TRX firmware from an older Luxul format image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Orchestrates the upgrade process based on the identified image type.
